panels.title: Nodes online
panels.description: Scraped chain targets currently answering. This counts the monitoring inventory, not the validator set: a validator that is not a scrape target is invisible here.

panels.title: Nodes down
panels.description: Configured chain targets minus the ones answering. Empty means no chain target is configured at all, which is not the same as nothing being down.

panels.title: Validators
panels.description: Size of the active validator set as the chain reports it. It changes every epoch, so read the sparkline rather than the number alone.

panels.title: P2P peers

defaults.noValue: no node reported a peer count

panels.description: Peer connections summed over scraped nodes. Empty means no node reported a peer count, which is not the same as an isolated network.

panels.title: Stalest chain sample

defaults.noValue: no chain sample in the lookback window

panels.description: Age of the oldest chain sample across scraped nodes. A single node falling behind raises this; it stays low only while every scraped node is fresh.

panels.title: Block interval p50

defaults.noValue: no block-interval histogram in the window

panels.description: Empty when no block-interval histogram was scraped in the window. A flat zero would read as instant blocks.

panels.title: Transactions per second
panels.description: Every node counts the same committed transactions, so their rates agree; this shows the highest one rather than their sum. A zero is a measured idle chain; empty means the counter was not scraped.

panels.title: Voting power signed

defaults.noValue: no consensus round sampled in the window

panels.description: Share of total voting power seen in precommit, taken as the peak of each minute because the gauge samples a round in flight, so it reads above one when a minute spans more than one round. The dashed line at two thirds is the floor below which a round cannot commit.

panels.title: Missed blocks by validator

defaults.noValue: no validator exports a missed-block counter

panels.description: Only a node running its own validator exports this counter. A host missing from this panel is not proven to be a perfect signer.

panels.title: Operational disk free

defaults.noValue: no matching filesystem on any scraped host

panels.description: Free space on the fullest real volume of each host. Every ext4, xfs, btrfs and zfs mount counts, so a volume absent from the inventory is still measured. The dashed lines are the 15% and 8% disk alert levels; the alerts also watch /boot volumes, which this panel leaves out.

panels.title: GPU utilization
panels.description: Empty when no accelerator host reports to the collector. A validator with no attached GPU, or a GPU host that is not a scrape target, contributes no series here rather than a zero.

panels.title: GPU memory used
panels.description: Empty when no accelerator host reports to the collector. A validator with no attached GPU, or a GPU host that is not a scrape target, contributes no series here rather than a zero.

panels.title: GPU temperature
panels.description: Empty when no accelerator host reports to the collector. A validator with no attached GPU, or a GPU host that is not a scrape target, contributes no series here rather than a zero.

panels.title: Scrape targets and locations
panels.description: Every configured host target, with its location when one was resolved. A Host absent from the monitoring inventory does not appear here at all.

panels.title: Software inventory

defaults.noValue: no Host has reported its software inventory

panels.description: Rows appear once the version collector has written its first inventory on a Host. An empty table means the collector has not reported yet, not that the Hosts run no software.

panels.title: Validators beyond the monitored set
panels.description: Largest validator set the chain reported in the last day, minus the chain targets this deployment scrapes. The public set includes validators the lab does not operate, so a positive number is a statement about coverage, not a fault.

panels.title: Targets down
panels.description: Scrape targets that failed their last attempt, across every job.

panels.title: Stalest collector file
panels.description: Age of the oldest textfile a collector wrote. node-exporter republishes the contents of a file on every scrape, so a frozen file keeps looking fresh unless this is watched.

panels.title: Targets down by job
panels.description: Failing targets per scrape job. A job at zero is answering; a job missing from this table is not configured at all.

panels.title: Collector freshness
panels.description: Seconds since each textfile was last written. A value that keeps growing is a collector that stopped while its last values are still being served.

panels.title: Scraped hosts without GPU telemetry

defaults.noValue: no row: every scraped host reports NVIDIA telemetry, or none is configured

targets.expr: count by (host) (up{job="host"} == 1) unless on(host) count by (host) (gdc_nvidia_available)

panels.description: Hosts that answer the host scrape but export no NVIDIA telemetry. Empty means either every scraped host reports it, or no host target is configured.

options.content: This board adapts the structure of **Gonka Network Pulse v4** to the Community DevNet metrics that are actually collected. It uses live CometBFT, host, GPU and blackbox-exporter series. Archive-only epoch economics, rewards and historical transaction decoding are intentionally not fabricated.
